name: Teamwork
label: Teamwork.com API
description: Teamwork Projects API v3 at https://{site_host}/projects/api/v3. Docs: https://apidocs.teamwork.com/docs/teamwork/v3. project_create / task_create / person_add nest official project / task / person objects. Bearer api_token. Handler: OfficialApiNode. Never log api_token.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Teamwork official API call. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Set operation plus the path/query/body fields that operation lists in api_spec.json. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"project_create"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP verb to run. Overrides instance operation when non-blank. EXACT accepted values: 'project_create', 'person_add', 'task_create', 'task_complete', 'subtask_create', 'milestone_create', 'company_create', 'calendar_event_create', 'link_create', 'listen'. listen/trigger/webhook_listen never open a socket — they return an error telling you to use a BPMN message event. Example: 'project_create'.

schema.label: project
schema.description: Project envelope escape hatch for project_create. Purpose fields name/description merge as project.* via bodyMap.

schema.label: person
schema.description: Person envelope escape hatch for person_add. Purpose fields firstName/lastName/email merge as person.* via bodyMap.

schema.label: project_id
schema.description: Request field for operations that declare `project_id` as a path, query, or JSON body key. Omitted/blank is dropped. Example: 'example-value'.

schema.label: tasklist_id
schema.description: Task list id for task_create (POST /tasklists/{tasklist_id}/tasks.json). Required for that op. Example: '2859633'.

schema.label: todo-item
schema.description: v1 todo-item envelope escape hatch for subtask_create. Purpose fields content/description merge as todo-item.* via bodyMap.

schema.label: task
schema.description: Task envelope escape hatch for task_create / task_complete. Purpose fields name/description/dueAt/startAt merge as task.* via bodyMap.

schema.label: task_id
schema.description: Request field for operations that declare `task_id` as a path, query, or JSON body key. Omitted/blank is dropped. Example: 'example-value'.

schema.label: milestone
schema.description: Official milestone wrapper for milestone_create. Keys: title, deadline (YYYYMMDD).

schema.label: company
schema.description: Official company wrapper for company_create. Keys: name (required).

schema.label: event
schema.description: Official event wrapper for calendar_event_create. Keys: title, start, end.

schema.label: link
schema.description: Official link wrapper for link_create. Keys: name, code (URL).

schema.label: name
schema.description: Project name on project_create (project.name) or task name on task_create/complete (task.name). Example: Website redesign.

schema.label: description
schema.description: Description on project_create (project.description), task_create/complete (task.description), or subtask_create (todo-item.description). Example: Kickoff Friday.

schema.label: firstName
schema.description: Person first name on person_add. Nested as person.firstName (Teamwork v3). Example: Ada.

schema.label: lastName
schema.description: Person last name on person_add. Nested as person.lastName. Example: Lovelace.

schema.label: email
schema.description: Person email on person_add. Nested as person.email. Example: ada@example.com.

schema.label: dueAt
schema.description: Task due date YYYY-MM-DD on task_create/complete. Nested as task.dueAt. Example: 2026-12-01.

schema.label: startAt
schema.description: Task start date YYYY-MM-DD on task_create/complete. Nested as task.startAt. Example: 2026-11-01.

schema.label: content
schema.description: Subtask title on subtask_create (v1 todo-item.content). Example: Write copy.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Handler result object. Success: status='ok', http_status, data (parsed JSON). Example: {"status":"ok","http_status":200,"data":{}}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Present on HTTP 2xx. EXACT value: 'ok'. Example: 'ok'.

schema.label: HTTP status
schema.description: Provider HTTP status code. Example: 200.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or the raw string when not JSON. Example: {}.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default official API call for this instance when input.operation is blank. EXACT accepted values: project_create, person_add, task_create, task_complete, subtask_create, milestone_create, company_create, calendar_event_create, link_create, listen. Default: project_create. Example: project_create.

configurationParameters.label: Api Token
configurationParameters.description: Provider credential for auth.type=bearer (configKey api_token). REQUIRED secret — StudioQuack secret binding only; never put this on INPUT. Never logged. Example: 'redacted-token'.

configurationParameters.label: Site Host
configurationParameters.description: Teamwork site hostname only (no scheme). Interpolated as https://{site_host}/projects/api/v3. Example: 'acme.teamwork.com'.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout for the official HTTPS call. Positive integer. Blank/0/negative → 25. Example: 25.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
